assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Vendors ship arm-mounted inspection as a packaged cell and cobots now arrive with the camera built in, but most plants still buy a fixed vision station because it is faster and easier to validate. The moving camera earns its place only where part variety defeats fixed optics, which is a real but narrow slice today.
advance_criteria: Inspection cells requalified for a new part without re-engineering the optics
Learned defect models accepted in customer quality systems, not just as a pre-filter
Cycle times competitive with fixed multi-camera stations
regress_criteria: Cheaper high-resolution fixed stations removing the reason to move the camera
